::: {.eyebrow}
Published · The Oncologist (2022)
:::

Widespread adoption of immune checkpoint inhibitors and targeted therapies for
metastatic melanoma has lowered melanoma-related mortality while raising
treatment costs. The paper documents how health care utilization varied across
systemic, non-adjuvant melanoma treatments between 2016 and 2020.
